en.text: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

zhSimplified.text: 耶和华晓谕摩西说：

zhTraditional.text: 耶和華曉諭摩西說：

en.text: “Command the children of Israel, that they bring to you pure olive oil beaten for the light, to cause a lamp to burn continually.

zhSimplified.text: 「要吩咐以色列人，把那为点灯捣成的清橄榄油拿来给你，使灯常常点着。

zhTraditional.text: 「要吩咐以色列人，把那為點燈搗成的清橄欖油拿來給你，使燈常常點着。

en.text: Outside of the veil of the Testimony, in the Tent of Meeting, Aaron shall keep it in order from evening to morning before the LORD continually. It shall be a statute forever throughout your generations.

zhSimplified.text: 在会幕中法柜的幔子外，亚伦从晚上到早晨必在耶和华面前经理这灯。这要作你们世世代代永远的定例。

zhTraditional.text: 在會幕中法櫃的幔子外，亞倫從晚上到早晨必在耶和華面前經理這燈。這要作你們世世代代永遠的定例。

en.text: He shall keep in order the lamps on the pure gold lamp stand before the LORD continually.

zhSimplified.text: 他要在耶和华面前常收拾精金灯台上的灯。」

zhTraditional.text: 他要在耶和華面前常收拾精金燈臺上的燈。」

en.text: “You shall take fine flour, and bake twelve cakes of it: two tenths of an ephah shall be in one cake.

footnotes.text: 24:5 1 ephah is about 22 liters or about 2/3 of a bushel

zhSimplified.text: 「你要取细面，烤成十二个饼，每饼用面伊法十分之二。

zhTraditional.text: 「你要取細麵，烤成十二個餅，每餅用麵伊法十分之二。

en.text: You shall set them in two rows, six on a row, on the pure gold table before the LORD.

zhSimplified.text: 要把饼摆列两行，每行六个，在耶和华面前精金的桌子上；

zhTraditional.text: 要把餅擺列兩行，每行六個，在耶和華面前精金的桌子上；

en.text: You shall put pure frankincense on each row, that it may be to the bread for a memorial, even an offering made by fire to the LORD.

zhSimplified.text: 又要把净乳香放在每行饼上，作为纪念，就是作为火祭献给耶和华。

zhTraditional.text: 又要把淨乳香放在每行餅上，作為紀念，就是作為火祭獻給耶和華。

en.text: Every Sabbath day he shall set it in order before the LORD continually. It is an everlasting covenant on the behalf of the children of Israel.

zhSimplified.text: 每安息日要常摆在耶和华面前；这为以色列人作永远的约。

zhTraditional.text: 每安息日要常擺在耶和華面前；這為以色列人作永遠的約。

en.text: It shall be for Aaron and his sons. They shall eat it in a holy place; for it is most holy to him of the offerings of the LORD made by fire by a perpetual statute.”

zhSimplified.text: 这饼是要给亚伦和他子孙的；他们要在圣处吃，为永远的定例，因为在献给耶和华的火祭中是至圣的。」

zhTraditional.text: 這餅是要給亞倫和他子孫的；他們要在聖處吃，為永遠的定例，因為在獻給耶和華的火祭中是至聖的。」

en.text: The son of an Israelite woman, whose father was an Egyptian, went out among the children of Israel; and the son of the Israelite woman and a man of Israel strove together in the camp.

zhSimplified.text: 有一个以色列妇人的儿子，他父亲是埃及人，一日闲游在以色列人中。这以色列妇人的儿子和一个以色列人在营里争斗。

zhTraditional.text: 有一個以色列婦人的兒子，他父親是埃及人，一日閒遊在以色列人中。這以色列婦人的兒子和一個以色列人在營裏爭鬥。

en.text: The son of the Israelite woman blasphemed the Name, and cursed; and they brought him to Moses. His mother’s name was Shelomith, the daughter of Dibri, of the tribe of Dan.

zhSimplified.text: 这以色列妇人的儿子亵渎了圣名，并且咒诅，就有人把他送到摩西那里。（他母亲名叫示罗密，是但支派底伯利的女儿。）

zhTraditional.text: 這以色列婦人的兒子褻瀆了聖名，並且咒詛，就有人把他送到摩西那裏。（他母親名叫示羅密，是但支派底伯利的女兒。）

en.text: They put him in custody until the LORD’s will should be declared to them.

zhSimplified.text: 他们把那人收在监里，要得耶和华所指示的话。

zhTraditional.text: 他們把那人收在監裏，要得耶和華所指示的話。

en.text: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

zhSimplified.text: 耶和华晓谕摩西说：

zhTraditional.text: 耶和華曉諭摩西說：

en.text: “Bring him who cursed out of the camp; and let all who heard him lay their hands on his head, and let all the congregation stone him.

zhSimplified.text: 「把那咒诅圣名的人带到营外。叫听见的人都放手在他头上；全会众就要用石头打死他。

zhTraditional.text: 「把那咒詛聖名的人帶到營外。叫聽見的人都放手在他頭上；全會眾就要用石頭打死他。

en.text: You shall speak to the children of Israel, saying, ‘Whoever curses his God shall bear his sin.

zhSimplified.text: 你要晓谕以色列人说：凡咒诅 神的，必担当他的罪。

zhTraditional.text: 你要曉諭以色列人說：凡咒詛上帝的，必擔當他的罪。

en.text: He who blasphemes the LORD’s name, he shall surely be put to death. All the congregation shall certainly stone him. The foreigner as well as the native-born shall be put to death when he blasphemes the Name.

zhSimplified.text: 那亵渎耶和华名的，必被治死；全会众总要用石头打死他。不管是寄居的是本地人，他亵渎耶和华名的时候，必被治死。

zhTraditional.text: 那褻瀆耶和華名的，必被治死；全會眾總要用石頭打死他。不管是寄居的是本地人，他褻瀆耶和華名的時候，必被治死。

en.text: “‘He who strikes any man mortally shall surely be put to death.

zhSimplified.text: 打死人的，必被治死；

zhTraditional.text: 打死人的，必被治死；

en.text: He who strikes an animal mortally shall make it good, life for life.

zhSimplified.text: 打死牲畜的，必赔上牲畜，以命偿命。

zhTraditional.text: 打死牲畜的，必賠上牲畜，以命償命。

en.text: If anyone injures his neighbor, it shall be done to him as he has done:

zhSimplified.text: 人若使他邻舍的身体有残疾，他怎样行，也要照样向他行：

zhTraditional.text: 人若使他鄰舍的身體有殘疾，他怎樣行，也要照樣向他行：

en.text: fracture for fracture, eye for eye, tooth for tooth. It shall be done to him as he has injured someone.

zhSimplified.text: 以伤还伤，以眼还眼，以牙还牙。他怎样叫人的身体有残疾，也要照样向他行。

zhTraditional.text: 以傷還傷，以眼還眼，以牙還牙。他怎樣叫人的身體有殘疾，也要照樣向他行。

en.text: He who kills an animal shall make it good; and he who kills a man shall be put to death.

zhSimplified.text: 打死牲畜的，必赔上牲畜；打死人的，必被治死。

zhTraditional.text: 打死牲畜的，必賠上牲畜；打死人的，必被治死。

en.text: You shall have one kind of law for the foreigner as well as the native-born; for I am the LORD your God.’”

zhSimplified.text: 不管是寄居的是本地人，同归一例。我是耶和华—你们的 神。」

zhTraditional.text: 不管是寄居的是本地人，同歸一例。我是耶和華－你們的上帝。」

en.text: Moses spoke to the children of Israel; and they brought him who had cursed out of the camp, and stoned him with stones. The children of Israel did as the LORD commanded Moses.

zhSimplified.text: 于是，摩西晓谕以色列人，他们就把那咒诅圣名的人带到营外，用石头打死。以色列人就照耶和华所吩咐摩西的行了。

zhTraditional.text: 於是，摩西曉諭以色列人，他們就把那咒詛聖名的人帶到營外，用石頭打死。以色列人就照耶和華所吩咐摩西的行了。
